method: v1.3.3 Q7, A55, tau .05, mean validation loss, 50 SGD steps, source-fitted normalization, frozen budgets
selection: support labels must all be valid; validation labels require finite nonnegative CPU at all H steps; at least B valid validation windows, else recorded failure; models selected before test
evaluation: future targets finite and nonnegative at all H steps; retain invalid-count denominators, stop if none valid; same windows for each model; evaluate MSE MAE Worst10
gaps: retain irregular timestamp gaps, encode elapsed seconds/1200 as frozen features; forecast horizon counts observations not clock-time
forecast_geometry: same original T=validation end minus 1 and B=test segment length minus 96 minus H plus 1, forecast starts at T; not claim calendar-regular horizons
independence: Materna history per user knowledge; some trace summaries exposed, 01-20 excluded; no claim absolute independence; Bitbrains later history not established
metrics_comparison: MSA-DTI vs PT_A57_ref and A55 within same VM,H,K,budget; paired VM aggregation; all failures retained
scenarios: only original measured traces in this run; separate predeclared synthetic scenarios later if specified
backend: GPU CUDA, deterministic torch, native GRU, seed SHA256 external-v133|VM|H|K
retry_provenance: 225 original cases were tested before retry of 11 GPU-failed Bitbrains selections; each retry selection sealed before its own evaluation.
